  attaches the CodeDR skill pack zip and says install.
---
# Install CodeDR skill pack

The detailed exam recipes live in the licensed CodeDR skill pack zip. Do not redistribute the pack files.

## Steps
1. Ask the user to attach their codedr-skill-pack zip (buyers get this from CodeDR.AI).
2. Unzip to `/workspace/codedr-skill-pack/codedr-skill-pack` (canonical path).
3. For each folder under `.cursor/skills/code-dr-*/`, ensure a matching skill exists that says: read that SKILL.md immediately and follow it exactly. Commercial license: do not redistribute.
4. Confirm `/` shows the eleven code-dr skills plus CodeDR exam.
5. Copy helpers into each project under exam when needed: scripts/codedr_report_generator.py and analysis/templates/report-template.html.
6. Tell the user to point at a repo and say full exam or invoke CodeDR exam.

If the pack is already at the canonical path, skip unzip and just verify the skills.

skills.content:
---
name: CodeDR exam
description: >-
  Use when running a CodeDR.AI diagnostic on a vibe-coded or AI-built app: full
  exam, synthesize, remediate, or HTML report.
---
Run the CodeDR.AI skill pack (v1.1.0) against the repo under exam. Eleven skills, four phases. Commercial license: do not redistribute the skill files.

Canonical files: `/workspace/codedr-skill-pack/codedr-skill-pack`

## Phases
1. Diagnose in parallel: structure, security, tests, deploy, quality. Optional: performance (web), architecture diagrams.
2. Synthesize after reports exist.
3. Remediate only if asked — dedicated branch, never push.
4. Evidence screenshots then HTML report if they want a shareable dashboard.

## Hard rules
- Diagnostics are read-only.
- Findings use [CRITICAL]/[HIGH]/[MEDIUM]/[LOW] with file and line.
- Do not put the pack in a public repo.
- Full exam prompt: Run the CodeDR diagnostics in parallel, then synthesize.
